src/
├── app/                          # Next.js App Router (Routing Layer)
│   ├── layout.tsx                # Root layout with sidebar + providers
│   ├── page.tsx                  # Dashboard (greeting, quick actions)
│   ├── voices/
│   │   └── page.tsx              # Voice explorer (library grid)
│   ├── text-to-speech/
│   │   └── page.tsx              # TTS page (textarea + settings + history)
│   ├── bulk-text-to-speech/
│   │   └── page.tsx              # Bulk/Long-form TTS
│   ├── voice-clone/
│   │   └── page.tsx              # Voice cloning (record / upload)
│   └── api/                      # Mock API routes
│       ├── tts/generate/route.ts
│       └── voice/clone/route.ts
│
├── components/                   # Shared UI Layer
│   ├── ui/                       # Primitives (Button, Slider, Input, Modal)
│   ├── layout/                   # Sidebar, Header, PageShell
│   └── common/                   # AudioPlayer, WaveformVisualizer, FileDropzone
│
├── features/                     # Feature-based Domain Layer
│   ├── tts/
│   │   ├── hooks/
│   │   │   ├── useTTSForm.ts            # TTS form state + validation + submit
│   │   │   ├── useCharacterCounter.ts    # Real-time char count + duration
│   │   │   └── useScriptInjector.ts      # Smart template injection + SSML
│   │   ├── services/
│   │   │   └── tts.service.ts            # API calls to /api/tts/*
│   │   ├── types/
│   │   │   └── tts.types.ts              # TTSForm, TTSResponse interfaces
│   │   └── constants/
│   │       ├── voices.ts                 # Multi-language voice catalog
│   │       └── templates.ts              # Script templates (review, horror, news)
│   │
│   ├── voice-clone/
│   │   ├── hooks/
│   │   │   ├── useAudioRecorder.ts       # MediaRecorder + Web Audio waveform
│   │   │   ├── useFileUpload.ts          # Drag-drop + validation
│   │   │   └── useVoiceCloning.ts        # Clone training flow + progress
│   │   ├── services/
│   │   │   └── clone.service.ts          # API calls to /api/voice/*
│   │   └── types/
│   │       └── clone.types.ts            # CloneState, VoiceProfile interfaces
│   │
│   ├── audio-player/
│   │   ├── hooks/
│   │   │   └── useAudioPlayer.ts         # Play/pause, time, seek, download
│   │   └── types/
│   │       └── player.types.ts
│   │
│   └── history/
│       ├── hooks/
│       │   └── useHistory.ts             # localStorage-based history
│       ├── services/
│       │   └── history.service.ts        # CRUD operations
│       └── types/
│           └── history.types.ts
│
├── lib/                          # Infrastructure
│   └── api-client.ts             # Fetch wrapper with error handling
│
├── hooks/                        # Global shared hooks
│   └── useLocalStorage.ts
│
├── utils/                        # Pure helpers
│   ├── format.ts                 # formatTime (MM:SS), formatFileSize
│   └── validation.ts             # Text, file validators
│
├── types/                        # Global types
│   └── global.types.ts
│
└── styles/
    └── globals.css               # Design tokens, animations, base styles
